OptiKey key symbols
===================

Gazer vendors keyboard icon path data from OptiKey:

  https://github.com/OptiKey/OptiKey
  originally KeySymbols.xaml

https://github.com/OptiKey/OptiKey/blob/main/LICENSE.txt

(see the repository LICENSE).
